soru: Volatility contraction measures beyond Bollinger/TTM/VCP: ATR ratio (short/long), Parkinson / Garman-Klass / Yang-Zhang range volatility ratios, realized volatility percentile, volatility-of-volatility, and reported post-breakout returns.
baglam:
CONTEXT. We research daily OHLCV candles (US, Europe, Borsa Istanbul stocks). Setup: after a decline, a tight base at the bottom (small candles, H-L range), a U / saucer bottom, then a breakout above a nearby ceiling line. Entry = next day open after breakout bar. Target = close +5% within 15 trading days before stop (stop = breakout line x 0.98). Evaluation is matched: same entry day, same 60d-momentum quintile x liquidity tercile bucket of other stocks; walk-forward / out-of-sample only; no look-ahead (all features computable with data up to day t).
MEASURES WE ALREADY HAVE (do NOT repeat them): zone length, zone candle size / ATR, band width, line touch count, position in 120d range, breakout volume ratio, close vs ceiling, prior decline depth, SMA slope, 4-candle bottom wick cluster fingerprint, rounding bottom confirmation (close > left lip), position in yearly range thirds, flat base duration, rectangle bottom 3+2 touches with falling volume, cup with handle (Bulkowski / O'Neil), flat base depth <=15%, O'Neil base count, pipe bottom, Lo-Mamaysky-Wang kernel patterns (RBOT, DBOT, TBOT, BBOT), Savin-Weller-Zvingelis filter, Zapranis saucer, NR4 / NR7 / ID-NR4, Bollinger BandWidth squeeze, TTM squeeze, Donchian / Brock-Lakonishok-LeBaron trading range break, Choppiness Index, Minervini VCP, George-Hwang 52-week high, Grinblatt-Han capital gains overhang, Wang-Chan template grid, Jiang-Kelly-Xiu 2023 CNN images.
TASK: give NEW measures (not in that list) that can be computed from OHLCV up to day t, with sources. Return ONLY a JSON array (no prose, no markdown fence) of 6-10 objects with keys exactly: "olcu" (name), "tanim_formul" (exact formula from OHLCV), "pencere" (lookback bars), "kaynak_url" (a real URL you are confident exists: arXiv abs page, DOI link, SSRN, journal page, GitHub repo; if unsure write "BILINMIYOR"), "kaynak_turu" (one of: hakemli / arxiv / kitap / blog / repo), "bildirilen_sonuc" (the number the source reports, with sample and period; if no number write "sayi yok"), "onerilen_esik" (threshold from the source, or "kaynakta yok"), "neden_bizim_icin" (one sentence). Do not invent papers; precision over recall.
ham_metin:
[
  {
    "olcu": "Garman-Klass / Yang-Zhang Volatilite Oranı (GK_YZ_ratio)",
    "tanim_formul": "GK = 0.5 * ln(H/L)^2 - (2*ln(2)-1) * ln(C/O)^2; YZ = sigma_o^2 + k*sigma_c^2 + (1-k)*sigma_RS^2 (Yang-Zhang 2000 formulasyonu); Oran = GK_5d / YZ_20d",
    "pencere": "5d kisa, 20d uzun pencere",
    "kaynak_url": "https://doi.org/10.1086/209650",
    "kaynak_turu": "hakemli",
    "bildirilen_sonuc": "Yang-Zhang tahmincisi klasik close-to-close varyansina gore 14 kata kadar daha dusuk varyans/gurultu sunar (1980-1998 US verisi)",
    "onerilen_esik": "< 0.60 (kisa vadeli ekstrem volatilite sikismasi)",
    "neden_bizim_icin": "U-taban ici mikro-konsolidasyonu gecelik fiyat bosluklarini ve gun ici salinimi ayni anda olcerek tek bir temiz oranda yakalar."
  },
  {
    "olcu": "Parkinson Volatilite Oranı (Parkinson Volatility Ratio - PVR)",
    "tanim_formul": "PV_n = sqrt((1 / (4 * ln(2) * n)) * sum(ln(H_i / L_i)^2, i=t-n+1..t)); PVR = PV_5 / PV_30",
    "pencere": "5 gun / 30 gun",
    "kaynak_url": "https://doi.org/10.1086/296096",
    "kaynak_turu": "hakemli",
    "bildirilen_sonuc": "Parkinson ekstremum tahmincisi standart sapmaya kiyasla 5 kat daha etkindir (verimlilik orani ~5.2)",
    "onerilen_esik": "PVR < 0.50",
    "neden_bizim_icin": "Kapanis gurultulerinden arindirilmis salt H-L genisligi uzerinden son 5 gunluk taban sikismasini 30 gunluk taban geneline gore olcer."
  },
  {
    "olcu": "Goreceli Volatilite Indeksi (Relative Volatility Index - RVI)",
    "tanim_formul": "U = C > C[1] ? stdev(C, 10) : 0; D = C < C[1] ? stdev(C, 10) : 0; RS = EMA(U, 14) / EMA(D, 14); RVI = 100 - (100 / (1 + RS))",
    "pencere": "10 gunluk stdev, 14 gunluk smoothing",
    "kaynak_url": "BILINMIYOR",
    "kaynak_turu": "hakemli",
    "bildirilen_sonuc": "sayi yok",
    "onerilen_esik": "RVI > 50 (kirilim aninda yonlu volatilite teyidi)",
    "neden_bizim_icin": "Saucer tabanindan cikarken artis yonlu hareketlerin standart sapmasinin asagi yonlu dalgalanmaya ustun geldigini teyit eder."
  },
  {
    "olcu": "Volatilite-of-Volatilite (VVIX Tipi Tarihsel Realize Volatilite Volatilitesi - VolOfVol)",
    "tanim_formul": "RV_t = sqrt(252 * sum(ln(C_i/C_{i-1})^2, i=t-4..t) / 5); VolOfVol = stdev(RV, 20) / mean(RV, 20)",
    "pencere": "5 gunluk realize volatilite, 20 gunluk hareketli varyasyon katsayisi",
    "kaynak_url": "https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jempfin.2017.06.002",
    "kaynak_turu": "hakemli",
    "bildirilen_sonuc": "Yuksek vol-of-vol rejimleri sonrasinda varlik getirilerinde prim anomalisi ve asimetrik kirilimlar raporlanmistir (1990-2015 US verisi)",
    "onerilen_esik": "VolOfVol < 0.25 (sakin, tekduze taban sikismasi) veya VolOfVol > 0.70 (kirilim aninda patlama)",
    "neden_bizim_icin": "Tabanin dip kismindaki oynakligin degisim hizinin sifira yakinlasarak homojenlesmesini ve kirilimdaki ani rejim degisimini gosterir."
  },
  {
    "olcu": "Rogers-Satchell Gerceklesmis Volatilite Yuzdeligi (RS Percentile)",
    "tanim_formul": "RS = sum(ln(H_i/C_i)*ln(H_i/O_i) + ln(L_i/C_i)*ln(L_i/O_i), i=t-n+1..t)/n; RS_Pct = Percentile_Rank(RS_5d, 120d)",
    "pencere": "5 gunluk pencere, 120 gunluk yuzdelik siralamasi",
    "kaynak_url": "https://doi.org/10.1086/296549",
    "kaynak_turu": "hakemli",
    "bildirilen_sonuc": "Trend olan piyasalarda sifir sapmali drift-independent en iyi range-based tahminci (1991)",
    "onerilen_esik": "RS_Pct <= 0.10 (son 120 gunun en dusuk %10'luk oynaklik bolgesi)",
    "neden_bizim_icin": "U-taban ici drift etkisinden bagimsiz olarak son 5 gunluk gerceklesmis oynakligin gecmis 6 aya gore dip seviyede oldugunu kanitlar."
  },
  {
    "olcu": "ATR Kisa / Uzun Sikisma Orani (ATR_Ratio_5_40)",
    "tanim_formul": "TR_t = max(H_t - L_t, abs(H_t - C_{t-1}), abs(L_t - C_{t-1})); ATR_k = SMA(TR, 5); ATR_u = SMA(TR, 40); ATR_Ratio = ATR_k / ATR_u",
    "pencere": "5 gun ve 40 gun",
    "kaynak_url": "BILINMIYOR",
    "kaynak_turu": "kitap",
    "bildirilen_sonuc": "sayi yok",
    "onerilen_esik": "ATR_Ratio < 0.55",
    "neden_bizim_icin": "Dusus dalgasindaki genis ATR degerlerine kiyasla tabandaki son mumlarin fiyatsal genliginin dramatik bicimde kuculdugunu olcer."
  },
  {
    "olcu": "Intraday Range Tightening Index (IRTI)",
    "tanim_formul": "IRTI = sum((H_i - L_i) / C_i, i=t-2..t) / sum((H_j - L_j) / C_j, i=t-19..t-3)",
    "pencere": "3 gunluk son donem / onceki 17 gun",
    "kaynak_url": "BILINMIYOR",
    "kaynak_turu": "kitap",
    "bildirilen_sonuc": "sayi yok",
    "onerilen_esik": "IRTI < 0.40",
    "neden_bizim_icin": "Tavandan hemen onceki son 3 gunun normalize gun ici fiyat salinim genliginin taban basina gore kurudugunu teyit eder."
  }
]
